Compared with manually designed dialogue guidelines, this framework

reduces the need for manually designed dialogue guidelines while incorporating response timing and multi-turn progression that generic quality or topical similarity cannot capture. By maintaining dialogue states probabilistically rather than choosing a single response strategy, BASiS can preserve multiple valid strategies for the same context.
